scope: Author review of 14 newly selected AlmaLinux advisories covering the 16 changed records within the exact 182-CVE component cohort; two Ubuntu critical advisories independently checked for host-risk context.

retrieval.method: Primary publisher pages rendered by the web search/open tool; direct shell requests to AlmaLinux returned HTTP 403.
retrieval.limitation: This file binds the author assessment and exact publisher URLs, not unretained HTML bytes. Full Linux CNA JSON byte hashes and immutable source URLs are independently recorded in the fresh 182-record inventory.

advisories.componentAssessment: The advisory describes the same Linux kernel implementation issue as the byte-identical Linux CNA record. It does not identify additional vulnerable code in the exact Ubuntu exported-header payload.
